capabilities.description: Register workers with explicit capability sets, concurrency limits, health state, metadata, and lifecycle transitions.
Route queued work by required capability, priority, available capacity, load, failure history, and deterministic tie-breaks.
Track task lifecycle, retry budgets, failed workers, requeue work after worker failure, and dead-letter terminal failures.
Record every orchestration transition in an integrity-chained event stream and verify the chain deterministically.
Serialize content-addressed in-memory swarm state and restore it with telemetry and assignment cross-reference validation.

Invoke actual registered workers through bounded adapters, stream lifecycle/result evidence back into the scheduler, and enforce timeout/cancellation/authority boundaries instead of only modeling assignments.
Persist workers, queued/active/dead tasks, telemetry, retry state, and snapshots across process restarts with transaction/integrity semantics.
Expose registration, task submission, status, telemetry, cancellation, and crystallization dispatch through a real authenticated service/API or MCP boundary.
capabilities.consumer: agent clients and external control planes

capabilities.description: Expose meaningful health/readiness tied to scheduler persistence and execution dependencies, not a process uptime string.
Encode the estate-wide purpose-first completion law, anti-shortcut rules, status model, deployment requirements, and estate exit condition as machine-readable authority.
Enumerate every accessible repository, including ownership, archived/fork state, visibility, default branch, and parent metadata, without representative sampling.
Drive repository workers to recover intention from total evidence and emit purpose, capability, and gap manifests before implementation.
Execute isolated repository work units in parallel, implement missing capabilities, run proof, push branches/PRs, and record truthful unresolved status.
Persist authoritative counts and unresolved failures across every in-scope repository until UNKNOWN/BROKEN/INCOMPLETE reach zero.
capabilities.consumer: human operator and estate control plane

capabilities.description: Build cross-repository dependency/lineage/shared-capability graphs so execution order, extraction, integration, and successor resolution are based on the estate as a system.
Deploy the naturally service-shaped swarm control plane as an always-addressable runtime with environment/secrets contract, health/readiness, logs, release workflow, and operational rollback.
